meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会只读分析仓库里所有 open 的 issue 和 PR:每个条目开一个后台 quick 任务,把带 GitHub permalink 证据的报告写进 /tmp/{时间戳}/,全程不改动 GitHub,不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你提到“triage”“triage issues”等关键词,或要求对某个仓库的 issue、PR 做只读梳理时触发。

say.text: triage 这个仓库所有 open 的 issue 和 PR
say.note: 每条开一个后台任务,报告落到 /tmp/

say.text: triage issues,每条结论都要 GitHub permalink 作证
triage PRs,每个 PR 单独出一份报告文件
say.note: 后台并发跑,输出 /tmp/{时间戳}/pr-N.md

howto.what_en: Claude read-only triages all open issues and PRs: one background quick task per item, each writing a report with GitHub permalinks into /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, or closes anything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", "github triage", or ask for a read-only pass over a repo's issues and PRs.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs in this repo
say_en.note: One background task per item; reports land in /tmp/

say_en.text: Triage the issues, back every claim with a GitHub permalink
say_en.note: Claims without a permalink are marked UNVERIFIED

say_en.text: Triage the PRs read-only, one report file each
